title: THE PIXEL GROUND
why: Job 86b: with the pixel look on, the floor is baked at one pixel per 2 world units from the same code (the seeded stream does not move), snapped to a 4 step ramp of each district hue with slab seams, strokes and grass teeth, and processed in 64 pixel tiles within a 4 ms frame budget (the earlier 256 pixel tile exceeded it on the VM). One quarter of the floor canvas memory, a stepped pixel look.
now: With the pixel look on (the default), the ground is chunky pixel art in stepped district colours, and the first seconds of a raid finish baking it. With the look off, nothing changes.
